verse.verse_1: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
verse.verse_2: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
verse.verse_3: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
verse.verse_4: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
verse.verse_5: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
verse.verse_6: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
verse.verse_7: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
verse.verse_8: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
verse.verse_9: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
verse.verse_10: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
verse.verse_11: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
verse.verse_12: Who will enter the Great Fire,
verse.verse_13: In which they will then neither die nor live.
verse.verse_14: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
verse.verse_15: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
verse.verse_16: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
verse.verse_17: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verse.verse_18: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
verse.verse_19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
